source_independence: Four distinct high-level OTA source programs; vendor FVF and Miller share circuit helpers and the vendor-connected dependency cluster. These are not four independent ancestry clusters. Report high-level-program results plus source-closure sensitivity.
sizing_rule: One declared transistor category varied symmetrically about each qualified default; every sizing has separate intended gold. No sizing is selected by a new outcome. Nondefault sizing qualification remains pending.
layout_stream_rule: First64=4x4x2x2, then remaining4^4 combinations in fixed lexicographic order. Geometry only selects first64 mask-distinct successful GDS. All generation failures and duplicates consume cost and stay in denominators. Never replace a DRC/LVS/PEX/electrical failure. Stop after256 generation attempts; insufficient64distinct is an admission failure, not permission to search further.
development_overlap_control: The second layout control has four new interior levels, disjoint from the old development endpoints; exact Boolean-mask dedup must still exclude any actual old geometry matches. Old labels and raw trials are never copied into this pool. Baseline control is separate known development context and is not one of the64 new combinations.

geometry_equality.operation: Flatten including paths/repetitions; convert physical coordinates to um; use original GDS precision; ignore text and PDK pin/label annotation layers; union each physical layer/datatype; remove common translation; exact XOR-empty equality on every layer. Area/bbox can reject but cannot certify equality.
geometry_equality.PDK_exclusion_binding: At main freeze enumerate the exact SKY130 glayers ending _pin/_label plus(64,44); save this explicit list. No physical conductor/device layer excluded.
geometry_equality.comparison_scope: each source/sizing plus known development masks; cross-source or different-N equivalence is separately reported, never a new source lineage

objective.aggregation: minimum over tt/ss/ff after all constraints pass

no_feasible_oracle.report: observed feasible fraction, budgeted unresolved/censored fraction and complete electrical infeasible fraction separately; no finite made-up penalty or fake regret

fidelities.interpretation: Descriptive geometry, not calibrated UGB prediction
R*C features have actual PEX acquisition cost; not a cheap pre-PEX L1

observes: tt AC at source-specific declared grid
fidelities.target_prediction: Only after train/validation calibration to worst-cornerUGB; otherwise descriptive nominal metric

fidelities.interpretation: Only this establishes complete constrained objective/S2

cost_contract.allocation: Charge source-to-GDS and PEX once on actual first acquisition, then reference dependencies. A reused artifact saves repeated work but retains its first acquisition cost. Global CPU samples are shared scheduling context, never summed across pools.
cost_contract.development_cost_limits: Existing pilots record stage wall times and total process/child CPU; they do not retrospectively establish missing per-stageCPU. New cost instrumentation and calibrated formal budgets remain pending.
cost_contract.failure_accounting: Include syntax/generation failures, duplicates, physical failures, PEX failures, incomplete numeric traces and timeout CPU/wall/queue costs; unresolved is not intrinsic infeasible.

promotion_methods.calibration: Fit same-target predictions and selection thresholds on separately assigned train/validation source groups only. Never fit or retune on these E2 evaluation pool labels.
